steps.en: A summary page lists the selected notices
steps.id: Halaman summary mendaftar notice yang dipilih

steps.en: Each notice shows its new stage, reason and remark
steps.id: Tiap notice menampilkan stage baru, alasan dan remark

steps.en: Summary appears once the stage is confirmed valid
steps.id: Summary muncul setelah stage dinyatakan valid
steps.why_en: The summary opens before the system checks the stage; the check only runs on the final button.
steps.why_id: Summary terbuka sebelum sistem mengecek stage; pengecekan baru jalan di tombol akhir.
